title: Cryogenic Atom Probe Specimen Preparation and Advanced in situ Coating
content: Recent advances in atom probe tomography (APT) have focused on overcoming challenges associated with preparing and analyzing needle-shaped specimens from diverse materials. Two innovative strategies, cryogenic focused ion beam (cryo-FIB) specimen preparation and in situ coating techniques, are dramatically expanding the scope of APT analysis, from solid state materials to beam-sensitive materials (frozen liquids and battery samples).
